drug.name: Calcipotriene 0.005% 69 gram topical foam aerosol
drug.usual_sig: Dispense a small amount of calcipotriene foam into the palm of your hand and apply a thin layer externally to the affected area and gently rub the foam into the affected area until it disappears into the skin. 3 to 4 times daily. For the scalp, apply calcipotriene foam to your scalp when your hair is dry. Part your hair and apply directly on the affected area. Wash hands with soap and water thoroughly after each application to avoid spreading to the eyes, face or other sensitive mucous membranes.

drug.usual_sig: Using the roll-on applicator massage a liberal amount of gel directly on the affected area, not more than 3 to 4 times daily. For adults and children above age 12 only.
